description: Inputs to the agent's dotenv reader. input is the file's content, or null for a file that does not exist. An ok case gives the map read from the file, before the caller picks the keys it knows. An error case gives the line number and the reason; the whole message is "refusing to start [config PATH:LINE]: REASON" for agent run and "cannot continue [config PATH:LINE]: REASON" for a command that starts nothing, and the exit code is 3. must_not_contain lists text from the line that the message must not repeat.

ok.name: hash inside a value is part of the value
duplicate key, the last line wins
a line holding only CR is blank
CR inside a value is kept
quote after the first byte of a value is kept
whitespace other than space and tab in a value is kept
keys of any shape are read; the caller ignores the ones it does not know
byte order mark becomes part of the first key
vertical tab inside a key is not rejected

error.reason: not in KEY=value form; the line is not shown, since it may hold a secret
